lines.text: After Samuel died, David went to the Wilderness of Paran, where a wealthy man named Nabal lived near Carmel with his wife Abigail.
David sent ten young men to Nabal at Carmel with a greeting of peace and a request for whatever he could spare.
Nabal asked who David was and refused him, so David told his men to strap on their swords, and two hundred followed him.

wrong_details.true: about four hundred men followed David

lines.text: Abigail secretly loaded donkeys with bread, wine, sheep, raisins and figs, then met David in a mountain ravine and bowed at his feet.
Abigail told Nabal everything that night while he was sober, and after the LORD struck him dead, she became David's wife.

wrong_details.wrong: that night while he was sober
wrong_details.true: in the morning, when Nabal was sober, after a night of feasting and drunkenness
